title: AI-Assisted Failure Prediction on Postoperative X-Rays: A Head-to-Head Comparison with Consultant Trauma Surgeons
summary: A prospectively assembled 466-patient application cohort (104 fixation failures) was classified from postoperative radiographs by a ResNet-50 trained on a disjoint 200-patient cohort. AI sensitivity was 96.15% and specificity 98.90%, exceeding the three surgeons numerically; the strongest surgeon difference was not significant. This supports an adjunct diagnostic result, pending external prospective validation. This supports an adjunct diagnostic result, not external prospective validation.
